nieuw.titel: Consider Swiftstride when falling back in good order
nieuw.tekst: Consider adding Swiftstride to a Fall Back in Good Order move to put more distance between your losing unit and its pursuer.
nieuw.waarom: He says the extra distance increases the chance that the opponent will not catch the unit with its pursuit roll.

bronnen.citaat: You can add swift stride to a fallback in good order

bron.citaat: creating a flank for a unit like this chariot.

extraCitaten.citaat: stubborn which creates a fallback in order for you to reform

aanvullingen.toelichting: Both recommend reforming after falling back in good order to expose the pursuing enemy to a supporting flank charge; he also names Stubborn as a way to obtain this reform.
